decisions.subject: MB17-Q1R: exception building types; MB17-Q1 is withdrawn
decisions.recommendation: MB17-Q1 (2026-10-29, "an exception applies only to the building types it names") is WITHDRAWN: it contradicts M-180(1), which follows the by-law's own x.40.1 "Applicable" clause and x.30.1(1): a lot exception's unit for a detached house also applies to the detached houseplex; M-180(2) the more permissive regulation prevails. Rule text: An exception applies to the building types it names and to those the by-law's applicability clause extends it to (M-180); MB17-Q1 is withdrawn.

decisions.subject: MB18-R1: existing-lot minimums are judged in the verdict layer
decisions.operator_quote: the rest proceed with your recommendations
decisions.recommendation: Lot-size and frontage minimums apply to creating a lot, not to an existing lot (M-158). The check lives in the verdict layer (blind harness and Phase 3 report), not Layer 2; exception carve-outs kept. Rule text: Existing-lot minimums are judged in the verdict layer, never as a Layer 2 failure of an existing lot (M-158).

decisions.subject: MB54-Q: neighbour data in Layer 2
decisions.operator_quote: the rest proceed with your recommendations
decisions.recommendation: Layer 2 uses no defaults (Spec 134 I10): a lot without neighbour data stays undecided in Layer 2; Phase 3 applies the FS-SB1/SB2 chain with its "needs survey" flags. Rule text: Layer 2 leaves front-yard averaging undecided where neighbour data is absent; Phase 3 applies the FS-SB chain, flagged.

decisions.subject: MB55-Q: Building Setback Overlay District A and the holding symbol
decisions.operator_quote: the rest proceed with your recommendations
decisions.recommendation: The Building Setback Overlay District A (600.10.10) gets a small keying round (it is outside the keyed scope today). The holding symbol's stored values ('H' in one place, 'Y' in another) are checked read-only and normalised to one form, with the source cited. Rule text: 600.10.10 District A is keyed in its own round; the holding symbol is normalised to one stored form from its source.

decisions.subject: MB45d-Q3U: a blank Sixplex membership reads as undecided for 600.60 units
decisions.operator_quote: the rest proceed with your recommendations
decisions.recommendation: Where parcels.in_sixplex_area is blank, the 600.60 unit reads "undecided", not the earlier unscoped reading. Fact (read-only 2026-10-30): blank on 7,748 parcels, all COMMON (7,046) or CONDO (702); no ordinary house lot. Rule text: A lot whose Sixplex Overlay membership is not held is undecided for 600.60 units.

decisions.subject: MB17-T: the harness headline on a tie
decisions.operator_quote: the rest proceed with your recommendations
decisions.recommendation: The harness compares the applicant's figure against our largest value across the options, per measure (GFA, height, storeys, footprint, units), not against one headline option chosen by a tie-break. Rule text: The applicant is compared, per measure, against the maximum across our options for its building type.

decisions.subject: MB-57-LANE: lane abutting length is computed from the lot and lane geometry (computation decision only)
decisions.recommendation: Compute, from the held lot polygon and the City lane centreline (toronto_centreline feature "Laneway"), the length of each lot's rear and side lot lines along a lane, for 150.8.30.20(1) (3.5 m) and 10.5.30.20(2)(B). Lane width is not held: disclosed. Lands on a DB night (operator go). Recorded here: the computation only. The along-lane distance is not set by this ruling; no by-law or City figure was found, so it returns to the operator on ~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-lane-distance.md before build. Rule text: Lane abutting length is computed from the lot and lane geometry; the along-lane distance is a cited figure, logged as a ruling.
